verdict.rationale: Sierra documents an Agent SDK for code-based agent building alongside a separate no-code Agent Studio UI, implying two parallel workflows rather than confirmed full API/UI parity; probes for a public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt both 404, giving no evidence of a complete, discoverable API surface matching UI capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit API-vs-UI feature parity documentation, a public API reference/OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that Studio-only features (knowledge editing, insights, ghostwriter prompts) are also API-accessible.
